_notes: SAMPLE CONFIG — DJI Mini 4 Pro wide camera, 4:3 photo mode, ported from the citrus-uav-pipeline setup.
DJI publishes 82.1 deg FOV with a 24 mm format equivalent; only a DIAGONAL 82.1 deg matches 24 mm,
so fov_type is 'diagonal' (horizontal FOV = 69.73 deg). Not lens-calibrated: no distortion model.
altitude_reference 'takeoff': DJI RelativeAltitude is height above the take-off point, which equals
AGL only if the ground under the drone is level with the take-off point (flat-terrain assumption).
name: DJI Mini 4 Pro (sample)
